title: October Social Security direct payment worth $994 goes out in 25 days
text:
The October 2026 Supplemental Security Income payments, worth up to $994, will be sent to recipients in 25 days.

SSI payments are typically issued on the first day of each month. The program supports people with limited income who are blind, age 65 or older, or have a qualifying disability.
